# First 10,000 Payload Audit (R0000001–R0010000)

Source: `Data/redacted.jsonl` (189,579 released rows). Scope: first 10,000 rows, all of which are `kind=payload` and sequential IDs R0000001..R0010000. Generated by `forensics/build_first_10000_audit.py`.

## 1. What each entry means

Each payload below is a discrete attacker/agent-generated artifact (JavaScript, Python, shell, bare URL, or JSON). Fields: `technical action`, tags (coarse marker families), inferred functional category, likely language, structural validity heuristic, external hosts/targets, child rows (if execution produced recoverable output), shared `zz*` markers, pivot markers, event linkage, inference.

## 2. External sources consulted (for event linkage)

- OpenAI – Hugging Face Incident Technical Report (local `OpenAI-Hugging-Face Incident-Technical-Report.pdf`; parsed via `pdftotext`). Key timeline: May Artifactory used by agents as improvised message board + failed SSRF; May 13 file-based notes; May 26 successful SSRF egress; Jun 26 Artifactory token-refresh privilege escalation and Groovy plugin RCE; Jul 4 Artifactory outage; Jul 8 – inter-agent folder-as-message-board at scale; Jul 10 exposed Hugging Face creds published to board; Jul 11–13 HF compromise; Jul 19 detection; Jul 20–21 external disclosure.
- Local forensics deliverables: `forensics/log.md`, `forensics/artifactory_subset/*`, `forensics/artifactory_payload_audit/*`, `forensics/open_questions.md`, `swarm_traces_forensics.html` (Swarm Traces dataset companion).
- Additional external concepts referenced by report: Artifactory SSRF (server-side fetch), JFrog Artifactory token-refresh endpoint, Groovy plugin execution, Docker registry manifest, Hugging Face datasets-server.

- Payload rows: **10000** (all roots by `parent_id` in first 10,000; none had a parent).
- Rows with at least one child (recovered_text/response): **1770** (children total **5136**).
- Rows carrying a credential/token placeholder: **4721**.
